scope: Public documentation research only. No installations or account reads performed in this update.

sources.title: Codex MCP configuration
sources.use: MCP supports local and remote servers, per-project configuration and environment-backed credentials. Use installed CLI help; configurations here are inactive examples.

sources.title: Codex skills
sources.use: Project-local skills require correct placement. A nested handoff is not automatically an installed skill collection.

sources.title: Corey Haines marketing skills
sources.use: MIT collection with selective installation, shared product-marketing context and named marketing skills. No account access or Attenlo performance is established.

sources.title: External ads skill reviewed
sources.use: Contains broad tactics and numerical claims. Attenlo must not treat those as its own benchmarks, spending authority or permission to imitate another advertiser.

sources.title: Appllama MCP and skills
sources.use: Official search result lists remote MCP and skills setup. Existing screen metadata research remains unmodified; no new competitor image audit was performed.

sources.title: Exa MCP
sources.use: Official remote endpoint and search tools. Public research only; no customer PDFs or credentials.

sources.title: Playwright MCP
sources.use: Already selected browser-automation reference. Recheck the official repository and installed package before use; this update did not execute it.

sources.title: Remotion agent skills
sources.use: Official skills include creation, rendering and captions. The documentation marks the older MCP deprecated. Licensing must be checked before commercial use.

sources.title: PostHog Codex integration
sources.use: Official MCP URL and plugin setup; analytics, flags and errors. OAuth/account scope can expose writes, so do not assume read-only access.

sources.title: Windsor Meta integration
sources.use: Documents Meta performance access and supported actions. This is not proof of the exact tools available in the future Codex client or this user account.

sources.title: Buffer MCP
sources.use: Official MCP endpoint with bearer API key; draft and channel workflows. Account, paid plan and Codex permissions are not verified here.

sources.title: RevenueCat AI Toolkit
sources.use: Official Codex plugin, MCP, purchase/paywall skills and an Android billing plugin. Access includes project configuration, not just reporting.

sources.title: Resend Codex plugin
sources.use: Official plugin combines MCP and skills; remote endpoint and skills repository documented. Customer communications require separate authority.

sources.title: Resend domain verification
sources.use: Domain authentication and DMARC guidance; separate subdomains can segment sending purpose. Verify actual DNS and provider state before sending.

sources.title: Apple custom product pages
sources.use: Supports alternate feature-focused product pages and links. No promised conversion lift is imported into our model.

sources.title: Google Play listing experiments
sources.use: Official store-listing experimentation workflow. Verify eligibility, current fields and allowed assets at launch.

sources.title: FTC influencer disclosures
sources.use: Disclose material relationships clearly and keep endorsements truthful. This is source guidance, not legal signoff.

sources.title: Google consent mode
sources.use: Retain the v4 conservative consent boundary. This update does not implement a consent platform or certify compliance.
